name: The Descending Angel of Guilliman: Captain Severus Returns with Heavy Armaments

cycle_advancement.world_state: Duel of Gods: The Void Ascendant vs The Angel of Guilliman

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The sky above the floating ruins of the Basilica splits open. A heavy assault gunship from the 'Honor of Macragge' breaks through the orbital smog, dropping Captain Severus straight back into the abyss. Clad in Indomitus Tactical Dreadnought Armor upgraded with shoulder-mounted Cyclone Missile Pods and wielding the crackling Hammer of Macragge, the Captain lands amidst the floating debris to face Kathryn Vane, The Void Ascendant.

completed_milestones.title: Captain Severus Re-Engages as Guilliman's Executioner
completed_milestones.consequence: Detecting the impossible apotheosis of Kathryn Vane as the host of Lord Malgakor, Captain Severus equipped the Chapter's sacred master-crafted relic weapons—the Hammer of Macragge and Cyclone Missiles—and dropped directly into the anti-gravitational vortex to finish the sanction personally.

active_disasters_and_trials.name: The Clash of Betrayal and Indomitus Duty
active_disasters_and_trials.threat: Captain Severus (102 HP, Strike Impact: 1,279.1 dmg, equipped with Cyclone Missiles and Sanctified Thunder Hammer) stands at the precipice of the floating Basilica crater, aiming his weapons at Kathryn Vane (640 HP, Strike Impact: 5,228.5 dmg).
active_disasters_and_trials.human_trial: Vane the Void Ascendant must decide how to confront her former savior: unleash the full apocalyptic fury of Malgakor to crush the Ultramarine, or break his will with the dark truth of the Primarch's betrayal.

command_and_specialists.name: Kathryn Vane, The Void Ascendant
command_and_specialists.role: Avatar of the Void / Host of Lord Malgakor

new_decision.decision: Witnessed the catastrophic void-resurrection of Kathryn Vane from the bridge of the Strike Cruiser; refused to bombard the hive from orbit and instead descended in personal drop-insertion armed with the Hammer of Macragge and Cyclone Missiles to meet the Void Avatar in single combat.
new_decision.impact: Initiated the final duel of Sub-Level 404.

new_decision.decision: Watched Captain Severus descend in heavy assault Terminator plate; raised Eclipser into a two-handed guard, surrounding herself with crackling violet warp-lightning, ready to strike down the angel of Guilliman.
